did_you_know.text: Did you know? After the death of her son Ahaziah, Athaliah tried to destroy all the descendants of the royal family in order to secure her rule.
Did you know? Jehosheba, Ahaziah’s sister, rescued the infant Joash and his nurse and hid them from Athaliah.
Did you know? Joash was hidden in the temple of the LORD for six years, while Athaliah ruled the land.
Did you know? In the seventh year, Jehoiada the priest summoned the commanders of hundreds and the guards, made a covenant with them, and had them swear an oath before showing them the king’s son.
Did you know? Jehoiada assigned the guards to different duties and positions around the royal palace to protect the king during the change of power.
Did you know? The weapons given to the guards belonged to King David and had been kept in the temple of the LORD.
Did you know? Joash was brought out to the people, the crown and the testimony were placed on him, he was anointed king, and the people shouted, “Long live the king!”
Did you know? Athaliah heard the sounds of celebration and the trumpet blasts, went to the temple of the LORD, and saw Joash standing by the pillar, as was customary for kings.
Did you know? After Athaliah was deposed, Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD, the king, and the people, as well as a covenant between the king and the people.
Did you know? The people tore down the temple of Baal, smashed its altars and idols, and killed Mattan, the priest of Baal, in front of the altars.
Did you know? Joash was escorted from the temple of the LORD to the royal palace, where he sat on the kings’ throne, and the people rejoiced while the city grew calm after Athaliah’s death.
